description: Governed legacy-agreement activation and authenticated historical settlement admission.

vectors.name: laa-current-payee-bound-success
vectors.note: current pay-bearing settlement uses the destination-bound artifact

vectors.name: laa-payee-bound-does-not-fallback-on-checkpoint-outage
vectors.note: checkpoint uncertainty never forces the safe current artifact onto legacy

vectors.name: laa-zero-pay-legacy-outside-gate
vectors.note: a pipeline with no payment introduces no runtime payout destination

vectors.name: laa-preactivation-authoritative-absence-allows-legacy
vectors.note: binding-qualified absence at an authenticated head proves activation has not occurred

vectors.name: laa-ca10-preactivation-legacy-commit
vectors.note: CA-10 permits legacy commitment only under authenticated preactivation absence

vectors.name: laa-fresh-legacy-after-checkpoint
vectors.note: a current legacy agreement cannot authorize payment after activation

vectors.name: laa-ca10-postactivation-legacy-commit

vectors.name: laa-backdated-generated-at
vectors.note: backdating agreement metadata cannot overcome a post-checkpoint commitment

vectors.name: laa-no-in-flight-transition
vectors.note: a pre-checkpoint commitment cannot initiate payment after immediate activation

vectors.name: laa-authentic-historical-settlement

vectors.name: laa-later-presentation-preserves-historical-era
vectors.note: presentation after activation does not change verified original anchor order

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-unavailable
vectors.note: transport failure is not proof that activation has not occurred

vectors.name: laa-ordinary-not-found

vectors.name: laa-other-substrate-absence-is-inert

vectors.name: laa-conflicting-checkpoints
vectors.note: multiple authorized checkpoint candidates do not establish an activation order

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-reorged
vectors.note: a reorged checkpoint receipt does not establish activation authority

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-signature-invalid
vectors.note: checkpoint must be signed by the authorized steward

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-signer-unauthorized
vectors.note: a valid signature from a non-steward is not checkpoint authority

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-address-mismatch
vectors.note: checkpoint fetched away from its derived fixed address is rejected

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-policy-mismatch
vectors.note: an artifact signed for another transition policy is not this checkpoint

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-cross-domain-signature
vectors.note: a signature under another artifact domain cannot activate the gate

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-malformed
vectors.note: malformed checkpoint bytes are structural error

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-multiple-discriminators
vectors.note: ambiguous checkpoint type is rejected before policy action

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-not-finalized
vectors.note: included-only checkpoint does not yet establish activation

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-substrate-mismatch
vectors.note: the checkpoint substrate must equal the authenticated session and receipt substrate

vectors.name: laa-checkpoint-cross-order-domain
vectors.note: a checkpoint from another consensus ordering domain is not position-comparable

vectors.name: laa-missing-commitment-era-proof
vectors.note: historical audit cannot infer agreement era without commitment authority

vectors.name: laa-commitment-hash-mismatch

vectors.name: laa-commitment-not-finalized
vectors.note: non-final commitment history is not era proof

vectors.name: laa-commitment-substrate-mismatch
vectors.note: a commitment receipt on another substrate cannot be ordered against this checkpoint

vectors.name: laa-commitment-cross-order-domain
vectors.note: equal-looking positions from different commitment order domains are incomparable

vectors.name: laa-missing-settlement-era-proof
vectors.note: old agreement alone cannot prove payment happened before activation

vectors.name: laa-settlement-binding-mismatch

vectors.name: laa-settlement-not-finalized

vectors.name: laa-settlement-cross-order-domain

vectors.name: laa-same-position-unorderable
vectors.note: same block without authenticated transaction order is not strictly earlier

vectors.name: laa-same-position-strict-order
vectors.note: binding-authenticated same-block transaction order can prove strict precedence

vectors.name: laa-backdated-evidence-observed-at

vectors.name: laa-deterministic-mismatch-precedes-outage

vectors.name: laa-malformed-agreement
